rules.statement: An appellate court will not depart from the rule it has laid down that it will not over-rule the decision of the Court below on a question of fact in which the Judge has had the advantage of seeing the witnesses and observing their demeanour unless they find some governing fact which in relation to others has created a wrong impression.
